data.cultural_impact: The name Riddhiman encapsulates the importance of wisdom and prosperity in Hindu culture. It signifies the desire for an individual to lead a prosperous life through the application of intelligence and wisdom. In Indian society, the pursuit of wealth is seen as a noble endeavor when it is accompanied by knowledge and insight.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Riddhiman carries a deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It implies that the name bearer possesses both material wealth (Riddhi) and spiritual wisdom (Man) - a rare and desirable combination in one's personal journey towards self-realization. It is a reminder that true prosperity comes not only from material possessions, but also from the inner wealth of knowledge and wisdom. By embodying the qualities of Riddhi (wealth) and Man (wisdom), the name Riddhiman inspires its bearer to strive for a balanced and fulfilling life.

historical_references.reference: There is a mention of a sage named Riddhima in the Hindu scripture Mahabharata. He was a disciple of sage Ashtavakra. Riddhima was renowned for his spiritual power and was able to attain the divine vision of Lord Vishnu, even in his waking state.

Riddhima is also mentioned in the Sanskrit epic, the Ramayana, as a sage who cursed Lord Rama for not fulfilling a promise. According to the epic, Riddhima was a sage who lived in the forest and had helped Lord Rama during his exile. When Rama failed to fulfill a promise made to him, Riddhima cursed him, causing a great drought in the forest.
